                    Data Dictionary                

                                    

                        Discover how we define our data, learn how to interpret our data, and how to use it.                    
                
                
                
                
                
                
                
                            
        

        
        
        
            





    
        

    
            

            Data Tools & Resources        
    
            

            Explore the data tools and resources we built to identify key housing and economic indicators.        
    
    
    


        
            
                                    
                        

    
    

        CoreData.nyc    

            

            Explore CoreData.nyc’s Subsidized Housing Database, the only property-level database of New York City’s subsidized housing.        
    
    

    

  Go to Tool


                    
                                    
                        

    
    

        State of the City    

            

            Citywide annual data that shows housing production trends, information on rents, demographics and incomes, and residential property values.        
    
    

    

  Explore the Data


                    
                                    
                        

    
    

        Neighborhood Data Profiles    

            

            Explore and download neighborhood indicators for each of New York City’s 59 community districts, including housing market conditions and development trends.        
    
    

    

  Search Neighborhoods
